title: Column Mapper
summary: Checks a spreadsheet column mapping against the actual values, so emails don't land in the phone field and DD/MM dates aren't read as MM/DD.
description: Checks a column mapping against sample values: emails in the phone column, first and last names swapped, DD/MM read as MM/DD (with a readback of what a date becomes), the same field mapped twice and required fields left unmapped, each with a one-tap fix.
catches: Values that don't fit the mapped field (an email in Phone)
First and last name columns swapped, using a first-name list
Day/month order misread, with a readback of what a sample date becomes
The same field mapped twice, and required fields left unmapped
limits: Works from the sample rows you pass; problems further down the file are not seen
Name-swap detection depends on the firstNames list and can miss uncommon names
a11y: After a fix, focus moves to the affected select
Issues use icons plus text, and each fix and keep action is a button
server: Validate types and required fields again on the server during import.
